NINJA_SLAYER_FEEDBACK_DESCRIPTION_PLACEH: Describe the issue or suggestion for the Ninja Slayer mod author...
NINJA_SLAYER_FEEDBACK_CONFIRM_BODY: Your feedback text will appear on the public Ninja Slayer observatory. Do not include private information in the text. The current screenshot and compressed game logs are sent only to the mod author and remain private. Logs may contain device, save and installed-mod information. This feedback is not sent to MegaCrit.
NINJA_SLAYER_SETTINGS_FREE_CONTROL_DESCR: Single-player play phase only. Free movement, dragging and attacks. Returns home when the turn ends.
NINJA_SLAYER_SETTINGS_FORCE_ALL_EVENTS_O: Prioritizes each eligible Ninja Slayer event once in subsequently created single-player runs. Existing runs are unchanged.
NINJA_SLAYER_TELEMETRY_DESCRIPTION: Share completed-run routes, choices, decks, results and combat use, damage, defense and resource statistics for balance analysis. Aggregate sharing does not publish individual battle reports or upload screenshots or logs. Disable here at any time.
NINJA_SLAYER_TELEMETRY_PENDING: Pending: no upload this session. If the first notice is dismissed or ignored, sharing starts next time the game launches.
NINJA_SLAYER_TELEMETRY_ENABLED: Enabled: completed runs contribute to public aggregate statistics.
NINJA_SLAYER_TELEMETRY_DISABLED: Disabled: run data will not be sent.
NINJA_SLAYER_TELEMETRY_NOTICE_BODY:
Ninja Slayer enables run data sharing by default to help balance cards. Data includes reward choices, final decks, results, and per-combat draws, plays and resources paid. The public observatory displays aggregate statistics only.

No automatic upload takes place this first session. Choose Enable now to start immediately. Dismissing or ignoring this notice enables sharing next time the game launches. Choose Disable sharing to keep it off. You can change this in Ninja Slayer settings at any time.
NINJA_SLAYER_TELEMETRY_REPLAY_DESCRIPTIO: Off by default. When enabled, record subsequent rooms, choices and turn-by-turn actions for anonymous public reports retained for 90 days. No account IDs, seeds, screenshots or logs. In multiplayer, only your contributed player details are published. Disable at any time; uncaptured sections are marked as missing.
NINJA_SLAYER_TELEMETRY_REPLAY_IDLE: No public report is being recorded.
NINJA_SLAYER_TELEMETRY_REPLAY_WAITING: Enabled. Recording begins in subsequent rooms.
NINJA_SLAYER_TELEMETRY_REPLAY_RECORDING: Recording locally; submitted when this run ends.
NINJA_SLAYER_TELEMETRY_REPLAY_TRUNCATED: Local recording limit reached. Existing data are retained and marked incomplete.
NINJA_SLAYER_TELEMETRY_REPLAY_STORAGE_ER: Local report storage failed. Existing files are retained; this report may have gaps.
NINJA_SLAYER_TELEMETRY_REPLAY_OVERSIZED: Report exceeds the free upload size limit. Kept locally, not uploaded.
NINJA_SLAYER_TELEMETRY_REPLAY_SUBMITTED: Handed to RitsuLib for submission and offline retries. Check the observatory for remote acceptance.
NINJA_SLAYER_SETTINGS_MANGA_SELECT_DESCR: Off by default: official front portrait with stronger scarf motion. Enable for the manga portrait and original hand animation. Only affects character selection; can be changed at any time.
NINJA_SLAYER_SETTINGS_BRIEF_BOSS_GREETIN: Enabled automatically after the first full greeting. Manual choices are retained and apply to the next greeting. Space shortens the current full greeting. In multiplayer the host decides, and only the host can press Space to switch.
NINJA_SLAYER_SETTINGS_NARRATION_DESCRIPT: Play narrator voice lines. Character voices and background music are unaffected.
